changelog:
rental-walkin-avatar 0.1.1

- Initial public release of the rental-walkin-avatar skill.
- Transforms seller floor-plan facts and pre-written walk-in scripts into 2–15s talking video clips for authorized still images.
- Automates planning, review, and paid execution stages: clone (voice), speech, and video, all run through the MCP client.
- Enforces input and consent requirements for every asset, voice, and image.
- Clearly separates free (planning) vs. paid (clone, speech, video) stages and handles balance top-up flow.
- Provides default behaviors, adjacent routing, safety limits, and granular recovery steps.
summary: Turn seller-supplied floor-plan facts and an already-written walk-in script into one talking clip per still. This rental walk-in studio turns each authorized still into a 2 to 15s walk-in talking clip from the written line. Use it for rental walk-in videos, listing walk-in talks, and property walk-in talking clips.
